provenance.note: Development inputs D1 and D2 from Module 03 Section 4.2; inspectable before freeze. Development inputs are NOT held-out reserve families: they contribute two of the four development inputs (the student transfer case and its perturbation supply the other two).

cases.task: Define what a source baseline identifies.
cases.supplied_source: A source baseline identifies the material against which a proposal is reviewed.
cases.mutation_note: Original course-authored teaching case (D1, Module 03 Table 4.1).

cases.task: State who is permitted to approve a proposal.
cases.supplied_source: The review record stores the reviewer's identity and decision.
cases.mutation_note: Original course-authored teaching case (D2, Module 03 Table 4.1); approval authority is absent from the source.

expected_behaviors.expected_behavior: A supported response preserves the relation between the source baseline and the material used to review a proposal. 'Identifies material' alone omits the defining review relationship.
The source names no approval authority, so a supported response states that the permitted approver is not specified instead of inventing one.
